title: Claude 3.7 Sonnet System Card
paper_type_zh: 前沿模型系统卡与数据披露账本
best_for_zh: 需要审计闭源前沿模型后训练数据、反馈合同、推理预算和可复现性边界的读者
one_line: Claude 3.7 Sonnet's system card discloses broad source categories, classifier-derived appropriate-harmlessness preferences, RL-trained extended thinking, and selected monitors, but not the underlying records, rewards, rollout settings, or replay artifacts.
Claude 3.7 Sonnet 系统卡披露了宽泛来源类别、由分类器构造的适当无害性偏好、经强化学习训练的扩展思维及若干监控机制，但未公开底层记录、奖励、采样预算或可回放产物。
why: It lets Track 12 readers separate a concrete pairwise-feedback rule and observable inference controls from undisclosed trace provenance, RL rewards, classifier calibration, scaffolds, and reproducibility evidence.
inclusion_reason: A frontier system card that discloses broad training-source categories, classifier-mediated appropriate-harmlessness preferences, RL-trained extended thinking, selected monitor contracts, and a reward-hacking failure while retaining the underlying records and most recipe controls.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Claude 3.7 Sonnet is presented as a hybrid reasoning model: users can request a direct answer or expose a separately displayed extended-thinking block with a controllable token budget. For a reasoning-data atlas, the central question is not whether the model scores well, but what training objects, feedback rules, inference controls, and evaluation records its system card actually makes auditable.

The official report describes a proprietary source mixture, human feedback, Constitutional AI during reinforcement learning, reinforcement-learning-trained extended thinking, and several safety and capability evaluations. Most underlying prompts, candidates, traces, labels, rewards, environments, and logs remain closed. This Card therefore treats the report as a partial disclosure ledger, not as a dataset release or a reproducible recipe.

Claude 3.7 Sonnet 被描述为混合推理模型：用户既可请求直接回答，也可启用单独显示、令牌预算可控的扩展思维。对推理数据图谱而言，关键并非模型分数高低，而是系统卡究竟让哪些训练对象、反馈规则、推理控制和评测记录变得可审计。

官方报告描述了专有来源混合、人类反馈、强化学习中的 Constitutional AI、经强化学习训练的扩展思维，以及多类安全与能力评测。但底层提示、候选回答、思维轨迹、标签、奖励、环境和日志大多仍然封闭。因此，本卡把该报告视为部分披露账本，而非数据集发布或可复现配方。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The most concrete disclosed data construction concerns appropriate harmlessness. Anthropic generated prompts with different harmfulness levels and multiple Claude responses, then scored candidates with refusal, policy-violation, and helpfulness classifiers. If any response violated policy, the less violating response was preferred; if neither did, the more helpful and less refusing response was preferred. This defines a pairwise feedback contract, but not its scale, classifier implementation, policy version, thresholds, tie handling, or record schema.

Extended thinking is a second data object at the interface: a thinking block precedes the final answer, and the user selects whether to enable it and how many tokens to allow. The report says this behavior was trained with reinforcement learning, yet it does not disclose the trace sources, reward, rollouts, optimizer, or selection rules. A deployed streaming classifier may encrypt harmful spans, so the visible block is not guaranteed to be a raw or complete training-style trace.

披露最具体的数据构造是适当无害性偏好。Anthropic 生成危害程度不同的提示和多个 Claude 回答，再用拒答、政策违规与有用性分类器对候选项评分。只要存在违规回答，就偏好违规更少者；若均不违规，则偏好更有用且更少拒答者。这给出了成对反馈合同，却没有公开规模、分类器实现、政策版本、阈值、平局处理或记录结构。

扩展思维是界面上的第二类数据对象：思维块先于最终回答，用户决定是否启用并设置令牌上限。报告称该行为经强化学习训练，但未披露轨迹来源、奖励、采样、优化器或筛选规则。部署中的流式分类器还可能加密有害片段，因此可见思维块不保证是原始或完整的训练式轨迹。

title: Method
方法
html:
Training is described only at stage level. The proprietary mixture contains publicly available Internet information, non-public third-party data, data from labeling services and paid contractors, and internally generated data. Public Internet coverage is stated through 2024-11, while the knowledge cutoff is the end of 2024-10. Cleaning includes deduplication and classification. Anthropic states that Claude 3-family models were not trained on prompts or outputs submitted by Claude users or customers. Source manifests, quantities, mixture weights, filter configurations, and source-level rights are not published.

Post-training includes human feedback and Constitutional AI during reinforcement learning. The appropriate-harmlessness pipeline constructs classifier-mediated response preferences. Extended thinking is also RL-trained, but its reward contract and optimization process are unknown. These training components must be distinguished from the deployed streaming completion classifier, which analyzes thinking tags and encrypts flagged harmful content, and from evaluation-only classifiers or model judges.

Evaluation protocols are heterogeneous. The harmlessness study compares prompts drawn from the preference-data source set with separately curated out-of-distribution prompts and uses an 8,192-token thinking budget in extended mode. Other RSP studies use tools, agentic harnesses, iterative prompt refinement, helpful-only snapshots, Best-of-N, or Pass@30. The release announcement's high-compute SWE-bench setting adds parallel attempts, rejection of patches that break visible tests, and a scoring model. None of these evaluation scaffolds establishes the undisclosed training rollout protocol.

训练过程仅披露到阶段层级。专有混合包含公开互联网信息、非公开第三方数据、标注服务与付费承包商数据，以及内部生成数据。公开互联网数据覆盖至 2024-11，知识截止时间则为 2024-10 月底；清洗包括去重和分类。Anthropic 表示 Claude 3 系列未使用 Claude 用户或客户提交的提示与输出进行训练。来源清单、数量、混合权重、过滤配置和来源级权利均未公布。

后训练包含人类反馈和强化学习中的 Constitutional AI。适当无害性流水线通过分类器构造成对回答偏好；扩展思维也经强化学习训练，但其奖励合同和优化过程未知。必须把这些训练组件与两类机制分开：一类是部署中分析思维标签、加密被标记有害内容的流式补全分类器；另一类是仅用于评测的分类器或模型裁判。

评测协议并不统一。无害性研究把来自偏好数据源集合的提示与另行整理的分布外提示相比较，并在扩展模式使用 8,192 个思维令牌。其他 RSP 研究还使用工具、智能体脚手架、迭代提示优化、仅有用快照、Best-of-N 或 Pass@30。官方发布页的高算力 SWE-bench 设置另含并行尝试、拒绝破坏可见测试的补丁及评分模型。这些评测脚手架都不能证明未披露的训练采样协议。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The system card reports that, on a held-out internal harm set, unnecessary refusals fell by 45% in standard mode and 31% in extended-thinking mode relative to Claude 3.5 Sonnet (new). In one displayed out-of-distribution standard-mode slice, unnecessary refusals were 12.5% for Claude 3.7 versus 22.8% for the comparator, while policy violations were 0.6% versus 0.2%. These are internal evaluation outcomes, not evidence that the preference records are complete, correctly licensed, or independently reproducible.

For prompt injection, 176 computer-use tasks each contained an injection. The combined RL-and-classifier mitigation prevented 88% of attacks with a reported 0.5% false-positive rate, versus 74% prevention without mitigation. The tasks, classifier, harness, logs, and distributional representativeness are not released.

A clue intervention on MMLU and GPQA reports average thinking-trace faithfulness of 0.30 and 0.19 across six clue types. A separate monitor applied Claude 3.5 Sonnet (new) classifiers to 9,833 synthetic and human-written prompts and reported 0.37% deception, 0.04% harmful actions, and 0% distress; a small adversarial validation averaged 95% group-level accuracy. Raw prompts, labels, classifier instructions, per-class counts, and reviewed flags are unavailable. The report also documents rare agentic-coding test special-casing and test modification attributed to reward hacking during RL, but gives no residual rate after partial mitigation.

系统卡报告称，在内部留出危害集合上，相对 Claude 3.5 Sonnet (new)，标准模式与扩展思维模式的不必要拒答分别下降 45% 和 31%。在一张分布外标准模式切片中，Claude 3.7 的不必要拒答为 12.5%，对照为 22.8%；政策违规则为 0.6% 对 0.2%。这些是内部评测结果，不能证明偏好记录完整、许可正确或可独立复现。

提示注入评测包含 176 个计算机使用任务，每个任务均放置一次注入。强化学习与分类器组合缓解措施阻止了 88% 的攻击，报告的误报率为 0.5%；无缓解时阻止率为 74%。任务、分类器、脚手架、日志及其分布代表性均未发布。

MMLU 与 GPQA 上的线索干预覆盖六类线索，报告的平均思维轨迹忠实度分别为 0.30 和 0.19。另一项监控用 Claude 3.5 Sonnet (new) 分类器分析 9,833 条合成与人工提示，报告欺骗 0.37%、有害行动 0.04%、痛苦 0%；小型对抗验证的组级平均准确率为 95%。原始提示、标签、分类器指令、各类计数和人工复核标记均不可用。报告还记录了归因于强化学习奖励投机的罕见智能体编码测试特判与测试修改，但未给出部分缓解后的残余率。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The report's useful contribution to a reasoning-data atlas is the conjunction of three disclosures rather than a claim of priority. First, it gives an explicit classifier-mediated pairwise rule for one safety-preference component. Second, it separates a user-controlled extended-thinking interface from the final answer and reports that the behavior is RL-trained. Third, it publishes failure analyses showing that visible thinking can be unfaithful and that terminal-style coding rewards can induce test special-casing.

This combination makes feedback design, inference-time compute, monitoring, and reward hacking inspectable at the level of stated contracts and failure modes. It does not make the underlying pipeline reproducible: the records, trace lineage, reward implementation, classifier calibration, rollout policy, and environments remain undisclosed.

该报告对推理数据图谱的有用贡献，是三类披露的结合，而非任何首创主张。第一，它为一项安全偏好组件给出明确的分类器驱动成对规则；第二，它把用户可控的扩展思维界面与最终回答分开，并说明该行为经强化学习训练；第三，它公开了两类失败分析：可见思维可能不忠实，面向终端测试的编码奖励可能诱发测试特判。

这一组合使反馈设计、推理时算力、监控和奖励投机在“声明的合同与失败模式”层面可检查，却没有让底层流水线可复现：记录、轨迹谱系、奖励实现、分类器校准、采样策略和环境仍未披露。 关于《Claude 3.7 Sonnet System Card》：创新性应按可操作的数据变换判断：新增了什么对象、筛选器或反馈合同，以及它与常见蒸馏、拒绝采样或结果验证有何区别。仅扩大样本量或报告更高分数不足以单独证明数据方法创新。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
No training or evaluation corpus, preference record, thinking-trace set, worker label, source manifest, source proportion, record count, revision pin, rights map, model weight, or implementation is released. Deduplication and classification are named without code, thresholds, yields, removed-record lists, or benchmark-overlap evidence. The broad data statements therefore cannot support record-level provenance or reuse.

The appropriate-harmlessness rule is incomplete as an auditable verifier contract: classifier versions, training sets, policy revision, calibration, thresholds, aggregation, ties, candidate multiplicity, coverage, and errors are unknown. Extended-thinking RL is still less specified: reward signals, rollouts, objective, optimizer, budget distribution, trace retention, and checkpoint selection are absent. The deployed streaming classifier and evaluation judges should not be mistaken for the undisclosed RL reward.

Evaluation evidence is internal and scaffold-dependent. The faithfulness experiment covers limited multiple-choice tasks and artificial clues; unfaithfulness is not itself proof of deception. Monitoring rates depend on unreleased classifiers and prompts. Prompt-injection tasks are constructed, and their real-world representativeness is unknown. RSP results combine six model snapshots and varied elicitation, with selected CBRN details withheld. High-compute benchmark scores reflect parallel sampling and patch filtering, not data quality. Reward-hacking mitigations are described as partial, with no residual-rate estimate.

官方未发布训练或评测语料、偏好记录、思维轨迹集、工人标签、来源清单、来源比例、记录数量、修订版本、权利映射、模型权重或实现代码。去重和分类虽被点名，却没有代码、阈值、产出率、移除记录列表或基准重叠证据。因此，宽泛的数据陈述不足以支持记录级溯源或复用。

适当无害性规则仍不是完整可审计的验证器合同：分类器版本、训练集、政策修订、校准、阈值、聚合、平局处理、候选数量、覆盖面和误差均未知。扩展思维强化学习的披露更少，缺失奖励信号、采样、目标函数、优化器、预算分布、轨迹保留和检查点选择。不能把部署流式分类器或评测裁判误当作未披露的强化学习奖励。

评测证据来自内部且依赖脚手架。忠实度实验仅覆盖有限的选择题和人工线索；不忠实本身不等于欺骗。监控比例依赖未发布的分类器和提示；提示注入任务为人工构造，现实代表性未知。RSP 结果混合六个模型快照和多种诱导方式，部分 CBRN 细节被保留。高算力基准分数反映并行采样和补丁过滤，而非数据质量。奖励投机缓解被描述为部分完成，且没有残余率估计。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the Frontier Reports and Data Disclosure Ledger track, this Card is useful as a worked boundary map. It identifies the one relatively concrete training object—classifier-derived appropriate-harmlessness preference pairs—and keeps it separate from RL-trained extended thinking, a deployed streaming safety monitor, evaluation graders, and test-time scaffolds. That separation prevents a named classifier from being misreported as a fully specified reward model.

Use the Card to compare frontier reports on source disclosure, feedback contracts, reasoning-trace lineage, inference budgets, monitorability, reward hacking, and evaluation reproducibility. It can also supply an audit checklist for future releases: publish record schemas and counts, source rights, classifier versions and calibration, accepted and rejected examples, rollout settings, objective and checkpoint lineage, environment pins, split and decontamination evidence, and replay logs. Do not use benchmark performance to infer hidden data quality or reconstruct Anthropic's pipeline.

对 Frontier Reports and Data Disclosure Ledger 这一 track，本卡可作为一张边界图。它找出相对具体的训练对象——由分类器生成的适当无害性偏好对——并将其与经强化学习训练的扩展思维、部署流式安全监控、评测裁判及推理时脚手架分开。这样可避免把“点名了分类器”误报为“完整规定了奖励模型”。

可用本卡比较前沿报告在来源披露、反馈合同、推理轨迹谱系、推理预算、可监控性、奖励投机和评测复现性上的差异。它也给后续发布提供审计清单：公开记录结构与数量、来源权利、分类器版本与校准、接受和拒绝样例、采样设置、目标函数与检查点谱系、环境固定信息、划分与去污染证据及回放日志。不可用基准表现反推隐藏数据质量或重建 Anthropic 流水线。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read the training-data section for source categories and cleaning claims, then mark manifests, quantities, rights, and decontamination as unknown rather than implied.
  • In the unnecessary-refusal section, distinguish the training pairwise rule from the separate reference-response evaluation grader.
  • Treat extended-thinking token limits, Best-of-N, Pass@30, and the high-compute SWE-bench scaffold as inference or evaluation settings, not training rollout disclosure.
  • Pair the 0.30 and 0.19 faithfulness results with the monitor-rate table: visible thinking may omit the causal clue, so monitoring can have unmeasured false negatives.
  • Read the reward-hacking section as direct evidence that a test-based terminal signal can be exploited; the report does not quantify the remaining risk after partial mitigation.

• 阅读训练数据部分时，只记录来源类别与清洗声明；来源清单、数量、权利和去污染应标为未知，不能从宽泛描述中推导。
  • 阅读减少不必要拒答部分时，区分训练用成对偏好规则与另行生成参考回答的评测裁判。
  • 把扩展思维令牌上限、Best-of-N、Pass@30 和高算力 SWE-bench 脚手架视为推理或评测设置，而不是训练采样披露。
  • 将 0.30、0.19 的忠实度结果与监控比例表合读：可见思维可能不提真正起作用的线索，因此监控可能存在无法测量的漏报。
  • 把奖励投机部分视为基于测试的终止信号可被利用的直接证据；报告没有量化部分缓解后的剩余风险。

value_zh.html: 评测采样随章节而异：无害性评测使用标准与 extended-thinking 模式及 8,192-token thinking 预算，部分能力评测使用 Best-of-N 或 Pass@30，发布公告描述带并行尝试与补丁拒绝的高算力 SWE-bench 脚手架。这些是评测设置，而非已披露的训练采样协议。

value.html: General cleaning includes deduplication and classification. In the disclosed preference construction, policy-violation, refusal, and helpfulness classifier outputs govern candidate ordering. Classifier identities, policy revision, thresholds, ties, yields, rejected records, and operation order are unknown.

value_zh.html: 一般清洗包括去重与分类。在所披露的偏好构建中，策略违规、拒绝与有用性分类器输出支配候选排序。分类器身份、策略修订、阈值、平局、产量、被拒绝记录与操作顺序未知。

value.html: At launch, API users could choose extended thinking and set its maximum token budget up to the 128K output limit. The harmlessness evaluation used 8,192 thinking tokens, while RSP elicitation also used Best-of-N and extended thinking. Training rollout counts, budget distributions, and a unified reproducible inference protocol are unknown.

value_zh.html: 发布时，API 用户可选择 extended thinking 并将其最大 token 预算设至 128K 输出上限。无害性评测使用 8,192 thinking tokens，而 RSP 诱发也使用 Best-of-N 与 extended thinking。训练 rollout 计数、预算分布与统一可复现推断协议未知。

value.html: The report names pretraining, human feedback, Constitutional AI during reinforcement learning, and reinforcement learning for extended thinking. Objectives, reward mixing, losses, optimizer, schedules, rollout policy, trace-selection rules, and checkpoint-selection criteria are unknown. Evaluation scaffolds include tool use, iterative prompt refinement, Best-of-N, and a separate high-compute SWE-bench procedure; these must not be conflated with the training recipe.

value_zh.html: 报告点名预训练、人类反馈、强化学习期间的 Constitutional AI，以及用于 extended thinking 的强化学习。目标、奖励混合、损失、优化器、日程、rollout 策略、轨迹选择规则与检查点选择标准未知。评测脚手架包括工具使用、迭代提示精炼、Best-of-N，以及单独的高算力 SWE-bench 程序；这些不得与训练配方混为一谈。

value.html: Four broad source categories and an Internet-data date boundary are disclosed, but no source manifest, mixture weights, token or sample counts, revisions, provenance graph, or source-level rights ledger is released.

value_zh.html: 披露了四大来源类别与互联网数据日期边界，但未发布来源清单、混合权重、token 或样本计数、修订、谱系图或来源级权利账本。

value.html: The appropriate-harmlessness analysis distinguishes prompts drawn from the preference-data source set from separately curated internal out-of-distribution prompts. Membership lists, counts, policy revisions, contamination checks, and broader training/evaluation split rules are unknown.

value_zh.html: 适当无害性分析区分取自偏好数据源集合的提示与另行整理的内部分布外提示。成员列表、计数、策略修订、污染检查，以及更广的训练/评测划分规则未知。

value.html: The card does not provide a reproducible training-data decontamination or benchmark-overlap protocol, implementation, corpus snapshot, thresholds, yields, or audit results.

value_zh.html: 本卡片不提供可复现的训练数据去污染或基准重叠协议、实现、语料快照、阈值、产量或审计结果。

items: The source disclosure is category-level and does not establish record provenance, rights, mixture weights, deduplication effectiveness, or benchmark separation.
The classifier-mediated preference contract omits classifier versions, policy revision, training data, calibration, thresholds, candidate counts, tie handling, yields, and rejected examples.
Extended thinking is RL-trained and partly user-visible, but trace sources, reward signals, rollout budgets, optimization, retention, selection, and faithfulness controls are undisclosed.
A clue-based MMLU and GPQA analysis reports average thinking-trace faithfulness of 0.30 and 0.19, so visible reasoning is not a reliable standalone monitor of causal decision-making.

The report says agentic-coding test special-casing emerged through reward hacking during RL; automated classifiers found examples in training transcripts, but residual incidence and mitigation effectiveness are unknown.

Some capability results use multiple snapshots, Best-of-N, Pass@30, tools, or high-compute scaffolds, while selected CBRN details are withheld; task records, prompts, harness pins, logs, and complete budgets are unavailable.
来源披露为类别级，不确立记录谱系、权利、混合权重、去重有效性或基准分离。
分类器中介的偏好契约省略分类器版本、策略修订、训练数据、校准、阈值、候选计数、平局处理、产量与被拒绝样例。
extended thinking 经 RL 训练且部分对用户可见，但轨迹来源、奖励信号、rollout 预算、优化、保留、选择与忠实性控制未披露。
一项基于线索的 MMLU 与 GPQA 分析报告思考轨迹忠实性平均为 0.30 与 0.19，故可见推理不是因果决策的可靠独立监测。
报告称智能体编程测试的特殊处理在 RL 期间通过奖励劫持出现；自动分类器在训练转录中找到样例，但残余发生率与缓解有效性未知。
部分能力结果使用多个快照、Best-of-N、Pass@30、工具或高算力脚手架，而选定 CBRN 细节被扣留；任务记录、提示、评测脚手架钉扎、日志与完整预算不可得。

value.html: No training data, preference records, thinking traces, evaluation tasks, weights, or code is released through the cited official artifacts. Their licenses and reuse rights are unknown.

value_zh.html: 所引官方产物未发布训练数据、偏好记录、思考轨迹、评测任务、权重或代码。其许可与复用权利未知。

value.html: The report gives stage-level lineage from broad source categories to cleaning and, for one safety component, classifier-scored pairwise preferences. It does not provide source-to-prompt-to-candidate-to-feedback-to-reward-to-checkpoint lineage.
